core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nimah corresponds to the Arabic form نِعْمَة (Arabic root ن ع م (n-ʿ-m); نِعْمَة (Niʿma)). Its core sense is nimah; blessing, favour. Nimah is Arabic نِعْمَة (Niʿma) 'blessing, favour', from the root ن ع م (n-ʿ-m). The source gloss 'Grace, Beauty' is broadly consistent. Same name as neima.

urdu.name: نعمہ
urdu.long_meaning: Nimah (نعمہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم نعمہ، نعمت ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: نعمه
persian.long_meaning: Nimah (نعمه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن نعمه، نعمت است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: निमा
hindi.long_meaning: Nimah (निमा) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ निमा, आशीर्वाद है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: نعمه
pashto.long_meaning: Nimah (نعمه) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې نعمه، نعمت ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: نِعْمَة
arabic.long_meaning: Nimah (نِعْمَة) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي النِّعْمَة، الرَّحْمَة. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

name_story.story: Nimah can be understood through the Arabic form نِعْمَة, whose central sense is nimah; blessing, favour. Nimah is Arabic نِعْمَة (Niʿma) 'blessing, favour', from the root ن ع م (n-ʿ-m). The source gloss 'Grace, Beauty' is broadly consistent. Same name as neima.

faq.a: Nimah is associated with the Arabic form نِعْمَة, whose core sense is nimah; blessing, favour.

faq.q: What is the origin of Nimah?
faq.a: Nimah is associated with Arabic. Nimah is Arabic نِعْمَة (Niʿma) 'blessing, favour', from the root ن ع م (n-ʿ-m). The source gloss 'Grace, Beauty' is broadly consistent. Same name as neima.
Yes — the underlying form نِعْمَة is Arabic.
Nimah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Nimah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Nimah mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Nimah is rendered نعمہ and carries the sense نعمہ، نعمت.

faq.q: What does Nimah mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Nimah is rendered نعمه and carries the sense نعمه، نعمت.
A romanized syllable approximation is ni-mah. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Nimah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Nimah, nimah. Script forms are نعمه, نعمہ, نِعْمَة, निमा.

faq.q: Is Nimah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
